name: wechatexplorer
description: macOS / Windows 微信聊天记录查看与 AI 群聊总结助手
author: Qingmao

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-env.cjs && node scripts/build-wechat-connector.cjs && electron-vite dev
scripts.test:wechat-connector: go -C services/wechat-connector test ./... && go -C services/wechat-connector vet ./...
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:native-services && electron-vite build
scripts.build:win: npm run typecheck && npm run build:wechat-connector:win && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --x64
scripts.build:mac:x64: npm run typecheck && node scripts/build-wechat-connector.cjs --platform darwin --arch x64 && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --x64
scripts.build:mac:arm64: npm run typecheck && node scripts/build-wechat-connector.cjs --platform darwin --arch arm64 && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --arm64
scripts.release: npm run release:mac && npm run release:win
scripts.release:mac: npm run typecheck && npm run build:wechat-connector:mac && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --x64 --arm64 --publish always
scripts.release:win: npm run typecheck && npm run build:wechat-connector:win && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --publish always
